2110051455503909112.en_summary: @amitisinvesting cites JPMorgan: 42 AI stocks account for 60% to 80% of S&P earnings growth, 60% of S&P 500 stocks are 20% below highs, and only 30% outperform the index, the lowest since 1991, asking whether such a top heavy market is healthy.
